action.description: Use status to read mission state. Use set-local or set-go-to with coordinate triples. Use set-takeoff, set-land, or set-return-to-launch for mission items matching the controller-supported MAVROS waypoint commands. Use wait-for with either mission or missionHash plus index to wait until that mission index is reached, or until the mission/mode changes.

tensorfleet-project-path.description: Optional Tensorfleet project directory path for legacy .tensorfleet/.env fallback.

mission.description: High-level mission item inputs. The tool converts these through MavrosMissionWaypoint before calling DroneController.sendMissionRequest(). Bare CLI point shorthand is parsed only by tensorfleet-cli.

items.description: One high-level mission item. Provide exactly one of goTo, takeoff, land, or returnToLaunch.

frame.description: Optional MAVROS mission frame. Defaults to GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT.

isCurrent.description: Whether this item should initially be marked current.

autocontinue.description: Whether the mission should automatically continue to the next item.

holdSeconds.description: Time to remain at the target before continuing.

acceptanceRadiusMeters.description: Distance at which the target may be considered reached.

yawDegrees.description: Optional yaw target in degrees. Omit to leave yaw unspecified.

frame.description: Optional MAVROS mission frame. Defaults to GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT.

isCurrent.description: Whether this item should initially be marked current.

autocontinue.description: Whether the mission should automatically continue to the next item.

yawDegrees.description: Optional yaw target in degrees. Omit to leave yaw unspecified.

altitude.description: Optional landing altitude in meters. Defaults to 0.

frame.description: Optional MAVROS mission frame. Defaults to GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT.

isCurrent.description: Whether this item should initially be marked current.

autocontinue.description: Whether the mission should automatically continue to the next item.

abortAltitudeMeters.description: Altitude at which an aborted landing should stop descending.

yawDegrees.description: Optional landing yaw in degrees. Omit to leave yaw unspecified.

frame.description: Optional MAVROS mission frame. Defaults to GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT.

isCurrent.description: Whether this item should initially be marked current.

autocontinue.description: Whether the mission should automatically continue to the next item.

missionHash.description: SHA-256 mission hash returned by status/set actions. For wait-for, provide either mission or missionHash.

waypointStart.description: First mission waypoint index to show for status output. Defaults to current index minus waypointRadius.

waypointEnd.description: Last mission waypoint index to show for status output. Defaults to current index plus waypointRadius.

waypointRadius.description: Number of waypoints to show before and after the current waypoint when waypointStart/waypointEnd are omitted. Defaults to 3.

index.description: Mission waypoint index to wait for when action is wait-for.
